offering_description.value: Designs and sells internet-connected exercise equipment such as stationary bikes, treadmills and rowers, along with subscription access to live and on-demand fitness classes. Sells to individual consumers and to commercial customers like gyms and hotels, through its own showrooms, website and retail partners. Equipment is made by contract manufacturers and content is produced in its own studios.

primary_products.value: connected stationary bikes; connected treadmills; connected rowers; strength training equipment; refurbished equipment

primary_services.value: digital fitness class subscriptions; equipment delivery and installation; equipment repair and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2C: home fitness consumers buying equipment and subscriptions; B2B: hotels, gyms, corporate and residential building fitness centers

end_markets.value: home fitness; wellness; hospitality; commercial fitness facilities

revenue_model.value: product sales: connected fitness equipment and accessories, including apparel; subscription: monthly all-access and app memberships for classes; rental or leasing: equipment rental and financing options; service fees: delivery, installation and repair
revenue_model.category: product sales; subscription; rental or leasing; service fees

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs equipment made by contract manufacturers, sold to consumers and businesses; software / platform: operates streaming fitness app and content platform for subscribers; retailer: sells directly through own showrooms and website

geography_served.value: global: US, Canada, UK, Germany, Australia and other markets, with US the largest

specialization.value: related lines: connected fitness hardware, digital class subscriptions and apparel/accessories

distribution_channels.value: online: own website and app sales; own locations: company showrooms; third-party retail: large retailers and resale partners such as Amazon, Dick's, Costco; direct sales: commercial sales to hotels, gyms and buildings
distribution_channels.category: online; own locations; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Consumer product safety rules (CPSC recalls), data privacy, music licensing and subscription/consumer protection laws
